recheck: minds --n selects prefix of fixed ID order. Static confirmation.

recheck: vote passes when yes>no regardless abstentions; yes1/no0/abstain15 passes original rule. Static arithmetic confirmation.

description: 去AI味要求可诱导无依据数字/经历/因果强化

description: 共同写作规则可能抹平角色特点，长度约定漂移
